description: This file implements a MemoryIndexManager class for managing memory search indices, including synchronization, error handling, and integration with external providers and storage. It also includes related functions for error recovery and cache management.

classes.name: MemoryIndexManager
classes.description: Manages a memory search index, handles synchronization, error recovery, and integration with embedding providers and storage.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a MemoryIndexManager instance based on configuration and purpose.

methods.name: applyProviderResult
methods.description: Applies the result of an embedding provider to the manager instance.

methods.name: ensureProviderInitialized
methods.description: Ensures the embedding provider is initialized before use.

methods.name: warmSession
methods.description: Prepares the index for a session start, optionally syncing.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search query, including keyword and vector-based search, with hybrid options.

methods.name: selectScoredResults
methods.description: Filters and slices search results based on score thresholds.

methods.name: hasIndexedContent
methods.description: Checks if the index has any content.

methods.name: searchVector
methods.description: Performs a vector similarity search.

methods.name: buildFtsQuery
methods.description: Builds a full-text search query.

methods.name: searchKeyword
methods.description: Performs a keyword-based search.

methods.name: mergeHybridResults
methods.description: Merges vector and keyword search results into a hybrid result set.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the index, with error recovery for read-only database errors.

methods.name: enqueueTargetedSessionSync
methods.description: Queues session-specific sync operations.

methods.name: isReadonlyDbError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a SQLite read-only database error.

methods.name: extractErrorReason
methods.description: Extracts a human-readable reason from an error.

methods.name: runSyncWithReadonlyRecovery
methods.description: Runs synchronization with automatic recovery from read-only errors.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads a file from memory storage.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the current status of the memory index, including counts and configuration.

methods.name: probeVectorAvailability
methods.description: Checks if vector search is available.

methods.name: probeEmbeddingAvailability
methods.description: Checks if embedding provider is available.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the index manager, releasing resources.
